# Heichel Discovery Fix Plan

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos joins head and body in one prepared vessel; Awtsmoos.com should consume the semantic fallback already rendered by the route, not seek the same light through a second uncertain path.

## Single-file correction

Rewrite only `heichelos/heichel/_awtsmoos.heichel.html`.

Preserve:

- every `heichel-mobile-007` stylesheet;
- every current mobile/cosmic script;
- all body/root classes and data attributes;
- the existing route-render root.

Change only the fallback boundary conceptually:

- remove the nested `$a("semantic/fallback.html", { semantic })` call;
- insert the already-prepared `semanticFallback` string with a safe empty-string fallback.

## Proof before broader crawl work

1. Re-read the whole rewritten template.
2. Verify line ceiling and diff whitespace.
3. Re-fetch root Heichel and known series from 8898 without restarting the verifier.
4. Require semantic fallback marker, H1, ordinary series/post links, and no template error.
5. If green, leave `discovery.js`, `shell.js`, and semantic fragments unchanged.
